1	//
2	//  AthleteContext.swift
3	//  Replog
4	//
5	//  A compact, pure digest of the athlete's REAL logged training data, rendered into the
6	//  on-device planner prompt so the model grounds loads, reps and exercise choices in what
7	//  the person has actually done — not generic guesses. All math is deterministic and
8	//  unit-tested; the model only ever sees the rendered summary text.
9	//
10	//  The on-device model's context window is small (~4k tokens), so the digest is budgeted:
11	//  `promptSection(maxTokens:)` drops the least-relevant lifts until the section fits.
12	//
13	
14	import Foundation
15	
16	/// Rough token accounting for prompts sent to the on-device model.
17	/// FoundationModels exposes no public token counter, so we estimate conservatively at
18	/// ~3.5 characters per token for English prose (real prose averages nearer 4).
19	enum PromptBudget {
20	    /// The on-device model's approximate context window (input + output), in tokens.
21	    static let contextWindow = 4096
22	    /// Tokens reserved for the model's structured response.
23	    static let responseReserve = 1400
24	
25	    /// Conservative token estimate for a piece of prompt text.
26	    static func estimatedTokens(_ text: String) -> Int {
27	        Int((Double(text.count) / 3.5).rounded(.up))
28	    }
29	
30	    /// Tokens left for additional prompt content once the fixed parts and the
31	    /// response reserve are accounted for. Never negative.
32	    static func remainingTokens(afterFixed parts: String...) -> Int {
33	        let used = parts.reduce(0) { $0 + estimatedTokens($1) }
34	        return max(0, contextWindow - responseReserve - used)
35	    }
36	}
37	
38	/// One lift's recent history, distilled to what a coach needs to program it.
39	struct LiftDigest: Equatable, Sendable {
40	    var exId: String
41	    var name: String
42	    var lastTopWeightKg: Double
43	    var lastTopReps: Int
44	    var currentE1rm: Int
45	    var bestE1rm: Int
46	    /// e1RM change of the latest session vs the prior one, or nil with fewer than 2 sessions.
47	    var trendPercent: Double?
48	    var sessionCount: Int
49	
50	    /// Full line for the framing prompt's history section.
51	    var promptLine: String {
52	        "\(name): last top set \(Self.kgText(lastTopWeightKg)) kg × \(lastTopReps), " +
53	        "est 1RM \(currentE1rm) kg (best \(bestE1rm) kg), \(trendText), " +
54	        "\(sessionCount) session\(sessionCount == 1 ? "" : "s") logged"
55	    }
56	
57	    /// Short annotation appended to a matching candidate in the selection prompt.
58	    var shortNote: String {
59	        "logged: last \(Self.kgText(lastTopWeightKg)) kg × \(lastTopReps), \(trendText)"
60	    }
61	
62	    private var trendText: String {
63	        guard let trendPercent else { return "no trend yet" }
64	        if trendPercent > 0 { return String(format: "up %.1f%% vs previous", trendPercent) }
65	        if trendPercent < 0 { return String(format: "down %.1f%% vs previous", -trendPercent) }
66	        return "flat vs previous"
67	    }
68	
69	    private static func kgText(_ kg: Double) -> String {
70	        kg == kg.rounded() ? String(Int(kg)) : String(format: "%.1f", kg)
71	    }
72	}
73	
74	/// Working sets logged for one muscle over the trailing week.
75	struct MuscleSetVolume: Equatable, Sendable {
76	    var muscle: Muscle
77	    var sets: Int
78	}
79	
80	/// The athlete's recent training, summarised for the planner. Pure value type:
81	/// build it with `make(history:catalog:now:)`, render it with `promptSection(maxTokens:)`.
82	struct AthleteContext: Equatable, Sendable {
83	    /// Per-lift digests, most relevant first (most-trained, then most recent).
84	    var lifts: [LiftDigest] = []
85	    /// Working sets per primary muscle over the trailing 7 days, highest volume first.
86	    var weeklySetsPerMuscle: [MuscleSetVolume] = []
87	
88	    var isEmpty: Bool { lifts.isEmpty }
89	
90	    // Nonisolated so it can serve as a default argument from any isolation context.
91	    nonisolated static let empty = AthleteContext()
92	
93	    /// The digest for a specific catalog exercise, if the athlete has logged it recently.
94	    func digest(forExId exId: String) -> LiftDigest? {
95	        lifts.first { $0.exId == exId }
96	    }
97	
98	    // MARK: - Building
99	
100	    /// Summarises history entries within the trailing `windowDays` (stale lifts are not
101	    /// coaching-relevant), keeping the `maxLifts` most relevant lifts. Entries whose
102	    /// exercise no longer resolves in the catalog are skipped.
103	    static func make(history: [HistoryEntry],
104	                     catalog: ExerciseCatalog,
105	                     now: Date = Date(),
106	                     windowDays: Int = 56,
107	                     maxLifts: Int = 10) -> AthleteContext {
108	        let calendar = Calendar.current
109	        let cutoff = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: -windowDays, to: now) ?? now
110	        let recent = history.filter { $0.date >= cutoff }
111	        guard !recent.isEmpty else { return .empty }
112	
113	        // Per-lift digests, reusing the tested progress math.
114	        var ranked: [(digest: LiftDigest, lastDate: Date)] = []
115	        for (exId, entries) in Dictionary(grouping: recent, by: \.exId) {
116	            guard let exercise = catalog.exercise(id: exId),
117	                  let latest = entries.max(by: { $0.date < $1.date }) else { continue }
118	            let progress = ProgressAggregator.summarize(exId: exId, history: entries)
119	            ranked.append((LiftDigest(exId: exId,
120	                                      name: exercise.name,
121	                                      lastTopWeightKg: latest.topW,
122	                                      lastTopReps: latest.topR,
123	                                      currentE1rm: progress.currentE1rm,
124	                                      bestE1rm: progress.bestE1rm,
125	                                      trendPercent: progress.trendPercent,
126	                                      sessionCount: progress.sessionCount),
127	                           latest.date))
128	        }
129	        ranked.sort {
130	            if $0.digest.sessionCount != $1.digest.sessionCount {
131	                return $0.digest.sessionCount > $1.digest.sessionCount
132	            }
133	            if $0.lastDate != $1.lastDate { return $0.lastDate > $1.lastDate }
134	            return $0.digest.name < $1.digest.name
135	        }
136	
137	        // Weekly volume per primary muscle (trailing 7 days).
138	        let weekCutoff = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: -7, to: now) ?? now
139	        var setsByMuscle: [Muscle: Int] = [:]
140	        for entry in recent where entry.date >= weekCutoff {
141	            guard let exercise = catalog.exercise(id: entry.exId) else { continue }
142	            let sets = max(entry.sets.count, 1)  // the top set exists even if setsJSON is empty
143	            for muscle in exercise.primaryMuscles {
144	                setsByMuscle[muscle, default: 0] += sets
145	            }
146	        }
147	        let weekly = setsByMuscle
148	            .map { MuscleSetVolume(muscle: $0.key, sets: $0.value) }
149	            .sorted {
150	                $0.sets != $1.sets ? $0.sets > $1.sets : $0.muscle.rawValue < $1.muscle.rawValue
151	            }
152	
153	        return AthleteContext(lifts: Array(ranked.prefix(maxLifts)).map(\.digest),
154	                              weeklySetsPerMuscle: weekly)
155	    }
156	
157	    // MARK: - Rendering
158	
159	    /// The history section for the framing prompt, or "" when there's no history or no
160	    /// budget. Drops the least-relevant lifts until the section fits `maxTokens`.
161	    func promptSection(maxTokens: Int) -> String {
162	        guard !isEmpty, maxTokens > 0 else { return "" }
163	        let header = """
164	        RECENT LOGGED TRAINING (real data — ground your loads, reps and exercise choices in it; \
165	        progress lifts trending up, hold or vary lifts that stall or regress):
166	        """
167	        let volumeLine: String = weeklySetsPerMuscle.isEmpty ? "" :
168	            "Working sets in the last 7 days: " +
169	            weeklySetsPerMuscle.map { "\($0.muscle.displayName) \($0.sets)" }.joined(separator: ", ") + "."
170	
171	        var included = lifts
172	        while !included.isEmpty {
173	            let body = included.map { "• " + $0.promptLine }.joined(separator: "\n")
174	            let section = [header, body, volumeLine].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: "\n")
175	            if PromptBudget.estimatedTokens(section) <= maxTokens { return section }
176	            included.removeLast()
177	        }
178	        return ""
179	    }

24	    /// A generated plan plus its saved report and which engine produced it.
25	    struct Result: Equatable, Sendable {
26	        var plan: GeneratedPlan
27	        var reportMarkdown: String
28	        var usedAppleIntelligence: Bool
29	    }
30	
31	    let generator: PlanGenerator
32	    let resolver: PlanResolver
33	    /// Forces the deterministic path (used by tests so they never invoke the live model).
34	    let forceFallback: Bool
35	    /// Sampling temperature — higher means more run-to-run variety.
36	    let temperature: Double
37	
38	    nonisolated init(catalog: ExerciseCatalog = .shared, forceFallback: Bool = false, temperature: Double = 1.0) {
39	        self.generator = PlanGenerator(catalog: catalog)
40	        self.resolver = PlanResolver()
41	        self.forceFallback = forceFallback
42	        self.temperature = temperature
43	    }
44	
45	    /// Whether Apple Intelligence can generate on this device right now.
46	    static var isAvailable: Bool {
47	        if case .available = SystemLanguageModel.default.availability { return true }
48	        return false
49	    }
50	
51	    /// Generates a plan + report. Uses Apple Intelligence when available, else falls back.
52	    /// `athlete` carries the user's real logged training (empty on first onboarding) so the
53	    /// model can ground loads, reps and exercise choices in actual history.
54	    func generate(_ answers: QuizAnswers, athlete: AthleteContext = .empty) async -> Result {
55	        guard !forceFallback, Self.isAvailable else {
56	            return Self.fallback(answers: answers, generator: generator)
57	        }
58	        do {
59	            return try await generateWithAI(answers, athlete: athlete)
60	        } catch {
61	            return Self.fallback(answers: answers, generator: generator)
62	        }
63	    }
64	
65	    // MARK: - Live two-stage generation
66	
67	    private func generateWithAI(_ answers: QuizAnswers, athlete: AthleteContext) async throws -> Result {
68	        let options = GenerationOptions(temperature: temperature)
69	
70	        // 1) Framing: the model designs the split + report sections.
71	        let framingSession = LanguageModelSession(instructions: Self.framingInstructions)
72	        let framing = try await framingSession.respond(
73	            to: Self.framingPrompt(for: answers, athlete: athlete),
74	            generating: PlanFraming.self,
75	            options: options
76	        ).content
77	
78	        guard !framing.workouts.isEmpty else {
79	            return Self.fallback(answers: answers, generator: generator)
80	        }
81	
82	        // 2) Per-day: the model selects + justifies specific real exercises.
83	        let weekdays = PlanGenerator.weekdays(count: framing.workouts.count)
84	        var workouts: [GeneratedWorkout] = []
85	        var reportDays: [PerDayNote] = []
86	
87	        for (index, day) in framing.workouts.enumerated() {
88	            let muscles = day.targetMuscles.compactMap { Muscle.lenient($0) }
89	            let candidates = generator.candidates(forMuscles: muscles, answers: answers, limit: 14)
90	            guard !candidates.isEmpty else { continue }
91	
92	            let count = max(3, min(6, day.exerciseCount))
93	            let selectionSession = LanguageModelSession(instructions: Self.selectionInstructions)
94	            let selection = try await selectionSession.respond(
95	                to: Self.selectionPrompt(day: day, candidates: candidates, count: count,
96	                                         answers: answers, athlete: athlete),
97	                generating: DaySelection.self,
98	                options: options
99	            ).content
100	
101	            let resolved = resolver.resolveDay(day: day, selection: selection, candidates: candidates)
102	            guard !resolved.items.isEmpty else { continue }
103	
104	            let weekday = index < weekdays.count ? weekdays[index] : Weekday.allCases[index % 7]
105	            let name = day.name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).isEmpty ? "Day \(index + 1)" : day.name
106	            workouts.append(GeneratedWorkout(name: name, day: weekday, items: resolved.items))
107	            reportDays.append(PerDayNote(
108	                dayName: name,
109	                text: selection.dayRationale.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines),
110	                exercises: resolved.notes
111	            ))
112	        }
113	
114	        guard !workouts.isEmpty else {
115	            return Self.fallback(answers: answers, generator: generator)
116	        }
117	
118	        let planName = framing.planName.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
119	        let headline = framing.headline.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
120	        let plan = GeneratedPlan(
121	            name: planName.isEmpty ? "Your Plan" : planName,
122	            colorHex: PlanGenerator.planColor(for: answers.goal),
123	            workouts: workouts,
124	            headline: headline.isEmpty ? "Your Plan" : headline
125	        )
126	        let report = PlanReport(
127	            philosophy: framing.philosophy,
128	            whyThisSplit: framing.whyThisSplit,
129	            perDay: reportDays,
130	            scienceNotes: framing.scienceNotes,
131	            safetyNotes: framing.safetyNotes,
132	            encouragement: framing.encouragement
133	        )
134	        return Result(plan: plan, reportMarkdown: ReportComposer.markdown(report: report, plan: plan),
135	                      usedAppleIntelligence: true)
136	    }
137	
138	    // MARK: - Deterministic fallback (no model). Directly unit-tested.
139	
140	    static func fallback(answers: QuizAnswers, generator: PlanGenerator = PlanGenerator()) -> Result {
141	        let plan = generator.generate(answers)
142	        let report = ReportComposer.fallbackMarkdown(answers: answers, plan: plan)
143	        return Result(plan: plan, reportMarkdown: report, usedAppleIntelligence: false)
144	    }
145	
146	    // MARK: - Prompts
147	
148	    static let framingInstructions = CoachingKnowledge.grounded("""
149	    You are an elite, caring strength & conditioning coach and exercise scientist who designs \
150	    safe, evidence-based resistance-training programs tailored to the individual. Use warm, plain, \
151	    encouraging language. Design the split and explain your reasoning thoroughly, citing the \
152	    principles below in plain words.
153	    """)
154	
155	    static let selectionInstructions = CoachingKnowledge.grounded("""
156	    You are an elite exercise scientist selecting specific exercises for one training day from a \
157	    provided list of real, available exercises. Choose the best mix of compound and isolation \
158	    movements for the day's muscles and the person's level and equipment. For EACH exercise, \
159	    explain in plain language what it trains and why it earns its place in this session. Only \
160	    choose from the numbered candidates given.
161	    """)
162	
163	    static func framingPrompt(for answers: QuizAnswers, athlete: AthleteContext = .empty) -> String {
164	        let base = """
165	        Design a personalized resistance-training plan for this person:
166	
167	        \(profileLines(answers))
168	
169	        Produce exactly \(answers.daysPerWeek) training day(s). For each day give a name, its 2-4 \
170	        primary muscle groups (lowercase single words), the number of exercises (3-6), and the rep, \
171	        RPE, and set scheme. Then write the report sections: philosophy, why this split and why these \
172	        muscles are paired together, the science, safety adaptations, and an encouraging note.
173	        """
174	        // The athlete's logged history gets whatever token budget the fixed parts leave over.
175	        let history = athlete.promptSection(
176	            maxTokens: PromptBudget.remainingTokens(afterFixed: framingInstructions, base))
177	        return history.isEmpty ? base : base + "\n\n" + history
178	    }
179	
180	    static func selectionPrompt(day: DayFraming, candidates: [Exercise], count: Int,
181	                                answers: QuizAnswers, athlete: AthleteContext = .empty) -> String {
182	        let list = candidates.enumerated().map { i, ex in
183	            let muscle = ex.primaryMuscles.first?.displayName ?? "—"
184	            let equip = ex.equipment?.displayName ?? "Bodyweight"
185	            let mech = ex.mechanic?.displayName ?? ""
186	            let base = "\(i + 1). \(ex.name) — \(muscle), \(equip)\(mech.isEmpty ? "" : ", \(mech)")"
187	            guard let digest = athlete.digest(forExId: ex.id) else { return base }
188	            return base + " [\(digest.shortNote)]"
189	        }.joined(separator: "\n")
190	
191	        let historyHint = athlete.isEmpty ? "" : """
192	         Candidates marked [logged: …] are lifts the person already trains — prefer keeping ones \
193	        that are progressing, and consider a variation where one stalls.
194	        """
195	
196	        return """
197	        Training day: "\(day.name)" focusing on \(day.targetMuscles.joined(separator: ", ")).
198	        Person: \(answers.goal.displayName), \(answers.experience.displayName), equipment: \
199	        \(answers.equipmentDescription)\(answers.injuries.isEmpty ? "" : ", limitations: \(answers.injuries.map(\.displayName).joined(separator: ", "))").
200	
201	        Choose exactly \(count) exercises for this day from the candidates below, in the order they \
202	        should be performed (compound movements first). Give the candidate number and a clear reason \
203	        for each.\(historyHint)
204	
205	        Candidates:
206	        \(list)
207	        """
208	    }
209	
210	    private static func profileLines(_ answers: QuizAnswers) -> String {
211	        var lines: [String] = []
212	        if !answers.fullName.isEmpty { lines.append("Name: \(answers.fullName)") }
213	        lines.append("Goal: \(answers.goal.displayName)")
214	        if answers.goal == .sport, !answers.sportLabel.isEmpty { lines.append("Sport: \(answers.sportLabel)") }
215	        lines.append("Experience: \(answers.experience.displayName)")
216	        lines.append("Gender: \(answers.gender.displayName)")
217	        lines.append("Age: \(answers.age)")
218	        lines.append("Height: \(answers.heightCm) cm")
219	        lines.append("Body weight: \(Int(answers.bodyWeightKg)) kg")
220	        if let bmi = answers.bmi {
221	            lines.append(String(format: "BMI: %.1f (%@)", bmi, answers.bmiCategory ?? ""))
222	        }
223	        lines.append("Training days per week: \(answers.daysPerWeek)")
224	        lines.append("Time per session: ~\(answers.minutesPerSession) min")
225	        lines.append("Equipment available (use ONLY these): \(answers.equipmentDescription)")
226	        lines.append("Injuries / limitations: \(answers.injuries.isEmpty ? "none" : answers.injuries.map(\.displayName).joined(separator: ", "))")
227	        return lines.joined(separator: "\n")
228	    }

2	//  PlanGenerator.swift
3	//  Replog
4	//
5	//  The on-device "AI": a deterministic engine that builds a training Plan from the
6	//  onboarding answers using the real exercise catalog. Same input -> same plan.
7	//  (The UI shows a ~1.8s "Building your plan" spinner over this work.)
8	//
9	
10	import Foundation
11	
12	// MARK: - Output (pure value types, no SwiftData)
13	
14	struct GeneratedSet: Equatable, Sendable {
15	    var weightKg: Double
16	    var reps: Int
17	    var rpe: Int
18	}
19	
20	struct GeneratedItem: Equatable, Sendable {
21	    var exId: String
22	    var sets: [GeneratedSet]
23	}
24	
25	struct GeneratedWorkout: Equatable, Sendable {
26	    var name: String
27	    var day: Weekday
28	    var items: [GeneratedItem]
29	}
30	
31	struct GeneratedPlan: Equatable, Sendable {
32	    var name: String
33	    var colorHex: String
34	    var workouts: [GeneratedWorkout]
35	    /// Display header on the result screen, e.g. "Your Hypertrophy Plan".
36	    var headline: String
37	}
38	
39	// MARK: - Generator
40	
41	struct PlanGenerator {
42	    let catalog: ExerciseCatalog
43	
44	    nonisolated init(catalog: ExerciseCatalog = .shared) {
45	        self.catalog = catalog
46	    }
47	
48	    /// Builds a complete plan for the given answers. Deterministic.
49	    func generate(_ answers: QuizAnswers) -> GeneratedPlan {
50	        let split = Split.choose(forDays: answers.daysPerWeek)
51	        let days = Self.weekdays(count: split.dayTemplates.count)
52	        let perWorkout = exercisesPerWorkout(minutes: answers.minutesPerSession)
53	        let allowed = answers.allowedEquipment
54	        let avoid = answers.avoidedMuscles
55	        let priority = priorityMuscles(answers)
56	
57	        var workouts: [GeneratedWorkout] = []
58	        for (index, template) in split.dayTemplates.enumerated() {
59	            let items = buildItems(
60	                for: template,
61	                priority: priority,
62	                count: perWorkout,
63	                allowedEquipment: allowed,
64	                avoidMuscles: avoid,
65	                answers: answers
66	            )
67	            workouts.append(GeneratedWorkout(name: template.name, day: days[index], items: items))
68	        }
69	
70	        return GeneratedPlan(
71	            name: split.planName,
72	            colorHex: Self.planColor(for: answers.goal),
73	            workouts: workouts,
74	            headline: headline(for: answers.goal)
75	        )
76	    }
77	
78	    // MARK: Exercise selection
79	
80	    /// Selects real catalog exercises for an arbitrary set of target muscles, honoring the
81	    /// user's equipment/injury constraints. Used by the AI resolver to map a blueprint's
82	    /// per-day muscle targets onto valid catalog exercises (guaranteeing images/refs exist).
83	    func selectItems(targetMuscles: [Muscle], count: Int, answers: QuizAnswers) -> [GeneratedItem] {
84	        let muscles = targetMuscles.isEmpty ? priorityMuscles(answers) : targetMuscles
85	        let template = DayTemplate(name: "", muscles: muscles)
86	        return buildItems(
87	            for: template,
88	            priority: priorityMuscles(answers),
89	            count: max(1, count),
90	            allowedEquipment: answers.allowedEquipment,
91	            avoidMuscles: answers.avoidedMuscles,
92	            answers: answers
93	        )
94	    }
95	
96	    /// Real catalog exercises the AI can choose from for a day's target muscles, honoring the
97	    /// user's equipment/injury constraints. Interleaves across muscles for balance and ranks
98	    /// compound-first; capped at `limit`. The model picks from (and justifies) this list.
99	    func candidates(forMuscles muscles: [Muscle], answers: QuizAnswers, limit: Int = 14) -> [Exercise] {
100	        let allowed = answers.allowedEquipment
101	        let avoid = answers.avoidedMuscles
102	        let target = muscles.isEmpty ? priorityMuscles(answers) : muscles
103	
104	        var perMuscle: [[Exercise]] = target.map { muscle in
105	            catalog.exercises(forMuscle: muscle)
106	                .filter { ex in
107	                    guard ex.primaryMuscles.contains(muscle) else { return false }
108	                    // Missing equipment counts as bodyweight, so a machine-only user never
109	                    // gets a bodyweight exercise slipped in.
110	                    if !allowed.contains(ex.equipment ?? .bodyOnly) { return false }
111	                    if !avoid.isEmpty, ex.primaryMuscles.contains(where: avoid.contains) { return false }
112	                    return true
113	                }
114	                .sorted { a, b in
115	                    let ra = rank(a, preferCompound: true), rb = rank(b, preferCompound: true)
116	                    if ra != rb { return ra < rb }
117	                    return a.name.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(b.name) == .orderedAscending
118	                }
119	        }
120	
121	        var seen = Set<String>()
122	        var result: [Exercise] = []
123	        var i = 0
124	        while result.count < limit, perMuscle.contains(where: { !$0.isEmpty }) {
125	            let m = i % perMuscle.count
126	            if !perMuscle[m].isEmpty {
127	                let ex = perMuscle[m].removeFirst()
128	                if seen.insert(ex.id).inserted { result.append(ex) }
129	            }
130	            i += 1
131	        }
132	        return result
133	    }
134	
135	    private func buildItems(
136	        for template: DayTemplate,
137	        priority: [Muscle],
138	        count: Int,
139	        allowedEquipment: Set<Equipment>,
140	        avoidMuscles: Set<Muscle>,
141	        answers: QuizAnswers
142	    ) -> [GeneratedItem] {
143	        // Order this day's target muscles by the user's global priority, then template order.
144	        let orderedTargets = template.muscles.sorted { lhs, rhs in
145	            let li = priority.firstIndex(of: lhs) ?? Int.max
146	            let ri = priority.firstIndex(of: rhs) ?? Int.max
147	            if li != ri { return li < ri }
148	            let ti = template.muscles.firstIndex(of: lhs) ?? 0
149	            let tj = template.muscles.firstIndex(of: rhs) ?? 0
150	            return ti < tj
151	        }
152	
153	        var chosen: [Exercise] = []
154	        var usedIDs = Set<String>()
155	
156	        // One pass picking the best exercise per target muscle, looping until we hit `count`.
157	        var pass = 0
158	        while chosen.count < count, pass < 4 {
159	            for muscle in orderedTargets where chosen.count < count {
160	                let candidate = bestExercise(
161	                    for: muscle,
162	                    allowedEquipment: allowedEquipment,
163	                    avoidMuscles: avoidMuscles,
164	                    excluding: usedIDs,
165	                    preferCompound: pass == 0
166	                )
167	                if let candidate {
168	                    chosen.append(candidate)
169	                    usedIDs.insert(candidate.id)
170	                }
171	            }
172	            pass += 1
173	        }
174	
175	        return chosen.map { ex in
176	            GeneratedItem(exId: ex.id, sets: setTemplate(for: ex, answers: answers))
177	        }
178	    }
179	
180	    /// The best catalog exercise for a muscle under the constraints, or nil.
181	    private func bestExercise(
182	        for muscle: Muscle,
183	        allowedEquipment: Set<Equipment>,
184	        avoidMuscles: Set<Muscle>,
185	        excluding usedIDs: Set<String>,
186	        preferCompound: Bool
187	    ) -> Exercise? {
188	        let candidates = catalog.exercises(forMuscle: muscle).filter { ex in
189	            guard !usedIDs.contains(ex.id) else { return false }
190	            // Equipment must be permitted; missing equipment counts as bodyweight.
191	            if !allowedEquipment.contains(ex.equipment ?? .bodyOnly) { return false }
192	            // Don't load an avoided region as a primary mover.
193	            if !avoidMuscles.isEmpty, ex.primaryMuscles.contains(where: avoidMuscles.contains) { return false }
194	            // Must actually target this muscle as primary for a strong stimulus.
195	            return ex.primaryMuscles.contains(muscle)
196	        }
197	        // Deterministic ranking: compound first (if preferred), then strength category,
198	        // then stable by name.
199	        return candidates.min { a, b in
200	            let aScore = rank(a, preferCompound: preferCompound)
201	            let bScore = rank(b, preferCompound: preferCompound)
202	            if aScore != bScore { return aScore < bScore }
203	            return a.name.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare(b.name) == .orderedAscending
204	        }
205	    }
206	
207	    private func rank(_ ex: Exercise, preferCompound: Bool) -> Int {
208	        var score = 0
209	        if preferCompound { score += ex.mechanic == .compound ? 0 : 2 }
210	        score += ex.category == .strength ? 0 : 1
211	        return score
212	    }
213	
214	    // MARK: Set/rep prescription
215	
216	    private func setTemplate(for ex: Exercise, answers: QuizAnswers) -> [GeneratedSet] {
217	        let setCount: Int = {
218	            switch answers.experience {
219	            case .beginner: return 3
220	            case .intermediate: return ex.mechanic == .compound ? 4 : 3
221	            case .advanced: return 4
222	            }
223	        }()
224	        let reps: Int = {
225	            switch answers.goal {
226	            case .buildMuscle, .recomp: return 10
227	            case .loseWeight: return 13
228	            case .sport: return 8
229	            }
230	        }()
231	        let rpe: Int = {
232	            switch answers.experience {
233	            case .beginner: return 7
234	            case .intermediate: return 8
235	            case .advanced: return 9
236	            }
237	        }()
238	        let weight = Self.startingWeight(for: ex)
239	        return Array(repeating: GeneratedSet(weightKg: weight, reps: reps, rpe: rpe), count: setCount)
240	    }
241	
242	    /// A sensible starting prescription (kg) the user can tune. Bodyweight = 0.
243	    static func startingWeight(for ex: Exercise) -> Double {
244	        switch ex.equipment {
245	        case .none, .bodyOnly, .bands, .foamRoll, .exerciseBall: return 0
246	        case .barbell, .ezCurlBar: return ex.mechanic == .compound ? 40 : 20
247	        case .dumbbell, .kettlebells: return ex.mechanic == .compound ? 16 : 8
248	        case .machine, .cable: return 25
249	        case .medicineBall, .other: return 6
250	        }
251	    }
252	
253	    // MARK: Priorities & cosmetics
254	
255	    private func priorityMuscles(_ answers: QuizAnswers) -> [Muscle] {
256	        // A known sport biases the plan; "Other"/custom sports have no fixed mapping
257	        // (empty priorities) and fall through to the general list below.
258	        if answers.goal == .sport, let sport = answers.sport, !sport.priorityMuscles.isEmpty {
259	            return sport.priorityMuscles
260	        }
261	        // General hypertrophy / recomp / fat-loss: big movers first.
262	        return [.chest, .lats, .quadriceps, .hamstrings, .shoulders, .glutes,
263	                .middleBack, .biceps, .triceps, .calves, .abdominals]
264	    }
265	
266	    private func exercisesPerWorkout(minutes: Int) -> Int {
267	        min(6, max(3, minutes / 12))
268	    }
269	
270	    private func headline(for goal: Goal) -> String {
271	        switch goal {
272	        case .buildMuscle: return "Your Hypertrophy Plan"
273	        case .loseWeight:  return "Your Fat-Loss Plan"
274	        case .recomp:      return "Your Recomposition Plan"
275	        case .sport:       return "Your Sport Plan"
276	        }
277	    }
278	
279	    static func planColor(for goal: Goal) -> String {
280	        switch goal {
281	        case .buildMuscle: return "#FF6A3D"
282	        case .loseWeight:  return "#2FA779"
283	        case .recomp:      return "#3D7DFF"
284	        case .sport:       return "#B36AFF"
285	        }
286	    }
287	
288	    /// Weekdays spread across the week for `count` training days.
289	    static func weekdays(count: Int) -> [Weekday] {
290	        switch count {
291	        case ...2: return [.mon, .thu]
292	        case 3:    return [.mon, .wed, .fri]
293	        case 4:    return [.mon, .tue, .thu, .fri]
294	        case 5:    return [.mon, .tue, .wed, .fri, .sat]
295	        case 6:    return [.mon, .tue, .wed, .thu, .fri, .sat]
296	        default:   return [.mon, .tue, .wed, .thu, .fri, .sat, .sun] // 7 days, no rest day
297	        }
298	    }
299	}
300	
301	// MARK: - Splits & day templates
302	
303	struct DayTemplate: Equatable, Sendable {
304	    var name: String
305	    var muscles: [Muscle]
306	}
307	
308	struct Split: Equatable, Sendable {
309	    var planName: String
310	    var dayTemplates: [DayTemplate]
311	
312	    static let push = DayTemplate(name: "Push Day", muscles: [.chest, .shoulders, .triceps])
313	    static let pull = DayTemplate(name: "Pull Day", muscles: [.lats, .middleBack, .biceps, .traps])
314	    static let legs = DayTemplate(name: "Leg Day", muscles: [.quadriceps, .hamstrings, .glutes, .calves])
315	    static let upper = DayTemplate(name: "Upper Day", muscles: [.chest, .lats, .shoulders, .biceps, .triceps])
316	    static let lower = DayTemplate(name: "Lower Day", muscles: [.quadriceps, .hamstrings, .glutes, .calves])
317	    static let full = DayTemplate(name: "Full Body", muscles: [.chest, .lats, .quadriceps, .shoulders, .hamstrings])
318	    static let arms = DayTemplate(name: "Arms & Core", muscles: [.biceps, .triceps, .forearms, .abdominals])
319	
320	    /// Picks a split appropriate to the number of training days.
321	    static func choose(forDays days: Int) -> Split {
322	        switch days {
323	        case ...2:
324	            return Split(planName: "Upper / Lower", dayTemplates: [upper, lower])
325	        case 3:
326	            return Split(planName: "Push · Pull · Legs", dayTemplates: [push, pull, legs])
327	        case 4:
328	            return Split(planName: "Upper / Lower", dayTemplates: [upper, lower, upper, lower])
329	        case 5:
330	            return Split(planName: "Push · Pull · Legs + Upper / Lower",
331	                         dayTemplates: [push, pull, legs, upper, lower])
332	        case 6:
333	            return Split(planName: "Push · Pull · Legs ×2",
334	                         dayTemplates: [push, pull, legs, push, pull, legs])
335	        default:
336	            // 7 days, no rest day: high-frequency week touching every region.
337	            return Split(planName: "Push · Pull · Legs + Upper / Lower + Arms",
338	                         dayTemplates: [push, pull, legs, upper, lower, arms, full])
339	        }
340	    }
341	}
